The Envoy Part I#003.src: I'm not from around here. In fact I am from Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#003.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#004.src: It's an independent island to the west. In fact.. If you want to go...
The Envoy Part I#004.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#005.src: We're looking for Wynn representatives. Head to the C.S.S Wavebreaker down at the dock if you want to experience Corkus. Enjoy Corkus if you go!
The Envoy Part I#005.speaker: Olivin

The Envoy Part I#006.src: Speak to C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain at the {p} docks.

The Envoy Part I#008.src: The only boat that'll take ye directly to {p}.
The Envoy Part I#008.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#009.src: Just hop aboard and make yerself comfy.
The Envoy Part I#009.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#011.src: Welcam aboard me ship, I'll bring ye directly to Corkus.
The Envoy Part I#011.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#012.src: Trust me, it is fa' more amazin than Gavel and Wynn. We even 'ave machines!
The Envoy Part I#012.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#013.src: And don't get me started on our architectur'!
The Envoy Part I#013.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#014.src: Trust me, you will enjoy yer stay.
The Envoy Part I#014.speaker: C.S.S Wavebreaker Captain

The Envoy Part I#017.src: It's such an honour to have a Wynn soldier visit our island.
The Envoy Part I#017.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#018.src: We were hoping for a true envoy, but you will do.
The Envoy Part I#018.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#019.src: If you follow me, I'll give you a tour of the city.
The Envoy Part I#019.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#020.src: We first arrived on Corkus {~} years ago.
The Envoy Part I#020.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#021.src: The Corkians, like you, are from Fruma originally...
The Envoy Part I#021.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#023.src: Coming from Fruma, we of course knew no magic at all.
The Envoy Part I#023.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#024.src: We soon developed our own. The rare power of Electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#024.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#025.src: It's a difficult modern branch of magic that allows us to create machines.
The Envoy Part I#025.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#026.src: Ah, here already. Welcome to {p}, Capital of our island.
The Envoy Part I#026.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#027.src: We've come a long way in a short time.
The Envoy Part I#027.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#028.src: Let me point out where the shops are.
The Envoy Part I#028.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#029.src: North, you can buy weapons and potions. If you will continue through the gate you will find the native Avos.
The Envoy Part I#029.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#030.src: West, you can buy armor, and another entrance to the potion shop.
The Envoy Part I#030.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#031.src: To the south is our bank, powder shop, scrolls, and our exclusive powder exchange!
The Envoy Part I#031.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#032.src: Oh! And speaking of the powder exchange, I'll start you off with some of these.
The Envoy Part I#032.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#033.src: Moving on... The south gate leads to {p}. On your way there, you might pass by the-
The Envoy Part I#033.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#034.src: Uhm, nevermind. In fact, we have a gift for you.
The Envoy Part I#034.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#035.src: The Five Gears Diner is hosting any guests of the island.
The Envoy Part I#035.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#036.src: Go through the western gate and head to the diner for your free feast. Enjoy!
The Envoy Part I#036.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#037.src: Walk towards The Five Gears Diner.

The Envoy Part I#041.src: Mo'in, Wynnian. Thank goodness I stopped you.
The Envoy Part I#041.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#042.src: The diner is being raided by mechs..
The Envoy Part I#042.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#043.src: Before we do anything, I have to explain what's happening here...
The Envoy Part I#043.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#044.src: My name is Maxie by the way. Nice to meet you.
The Envoy Part I#044.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#045.src: This town is usually full of life.
The Envoy Part I#045.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#047.src: Our creations have rebelled against us.
The Envoy Part I#047.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#048.src: They now raid towns for parts.
The Envoy Part I#048.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#049.src: Mechs are getting increasingly more desperate.
The Envoy Part I#049.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#050.src: Even in rust, they are still powerful.
The Envoy Part I#050.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#051.src: We have tried to remove them but the factory always makes more.
The Envoy Part I#051.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#052.src: It is Corkus' greatest failure. It must be stopped.
The Envoy Part I#052.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#054.src: I can try to open the vent to sneak in.
The Envoy Part I#054.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#055.src: I know you are a stranger, but talk to me if you want to help.
The Envoy Part I#055.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#058.src: Alright, I'll open the door with electromagic.
The Envoy Part I#058.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#060.src: Gah! I can't even do the most basic spell!
The Envoy Part I#060.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#063.src: I'm sorry for being useless in front of you...
The Envoy Part I#063.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#064.src: Electromagic is different from your magic.. I'm not very good at it...
The Envoy Part I#064.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#065.src: I'm not sure which way it is, let's split up. I'll go to the right.
The Envoy Part I#065.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#067.src: Open the door and exit the ducts.

The Envoy Part I#072.src: Mo'in. Sorry had a problem with the-
The Envoy Part I#072.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#073.src: What in the world is that mech on top of the pile of scrap over there?
The Envoy Part I#073.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#074.src: That is definitely not a regular despermech... It looks brand new!
The Envoy Part I#074.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#075.src: One of those hasn't been seen since the factory was running...
The Envoy Part I#075.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#076.src: We need to do something! I'll clear the path for you. That's the only thing I can do, I... hurt my... leg.
The Envoy Part I#076.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#080.src: Are you okay? Good. Meet me at the entrance where we met. We need to report to {p}!
The Envoy Part I#080.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#081.src: Talk to Maxie at the entrance to The Five Gears Diner.

The Envoy Part I#082.src: Don't worry about the guards, they are disabled for now. Follow me.
The Envoy Part I#082.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#083.src: I know a shortcut, we'll be in {p} in no time.
The Envoy Part I#083.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#084.src: Talk to Maxie and Corkus Delegate in {p}.

The Envoy Part I#086.src: Beltrude, we have a problem! The factory is running!
The Envoy Part I#086.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#087.src: We saw a mech... A new mech! It looked different like it was made in-
The Envoy Part I#087.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#088.src: What a load of scrap! You shouldn't talk about that in front of our guest!
The Envoy Part I#088.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#089.src: Our guest... just killed several despermechs by himself.
The Envoy Part I#089.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#090.src: And why would we take the word of someone who can't do basic electromagic?
The Envoy Part I#090.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#091.src: Don't listen to Maxie. Enjoy your stay.
The Envoy Part I#091.speaker: Corkus Delegate

The Envoy Part I#092.src: They won't admit anything with you around. They want to become allies with Wynn.
The Envoy Part I#092.speaker: Maxie

The Envoy Part I#093.src: Come to my house when you reach level {~}, here's a key so you can get in. We must prepare to break into the factory.
The Envoy Part I#093.speaker: Maxie
